scope: Source-to-native inspection of the single retained benign A/B protected-ownership execution; no new kernel execution or tests.
result: No material source-to-native discrepancy found for the retained 26-instruction, 660-byte image under the stated trusted-boundary assumptions.

findings.obligation: Every BPF branch enters a full instruction or common exit
findings.evidence: BPF PC2/native 0x104 -> 0x1c4 (PC24); PC7/0x134 -> 0x194 (PC19). EXIT PCs18/23/25 at 0x190/0x1c0/0x1d4 -> 0x1d8 RET CLR. Both forward NULL branches and all exit transfers match the retained PC map.

findings.obligation: Full public capability copies and one complete spill
findings.evidence: BPF register map r0=c7,r1=c0,r6=c19,r7=c20,r8=c21,r9=c22. All body register copies decode as MOV cN,cM. PC4/native 0x10c stores c19 to [csp,#0]; PCs9/19 at 0x13c/0x194 reload complete c21 from [csp,#0]. These are the only three memory instructions in the BPF body.

findings.obligation: All body calls use the fixed sealed executive gateway
findings.evidence: Six static call templates at PCs1,6,11,13,16,21 contain op selectors1,1,3,2,3,3 and their source PCs, MOV c13,c30, BLRS c17, MOV c7,c0. No ordinary BL/BLR, indirect branch, system-register instruction, capability construction or object-memory load occurs in native body [0xe0,0x1d8).

findings.obligation: Entry and exit ranges bind the trusted transitions
findings.evidence: Prologue BLR at0x60 materializes cbpf_enter=0xffff80008003ec7c; ADR at0x34 targets executive entry0x1dc, size184. Success resumes at0x64, branches over the executive-only failure path to0x70 and clears all GP/cap registers0..29 exceptx15/c17 before body0xe0. Restricted bounds observed: base0xffff8000812c2ba4, size376; executive base0xffff8000812c2d1c, size184. The only branch out of restricted PCC in the entry prefix is the executive-entry-error branch, whose execution requires cbpf_enter to return an error in executive mode; successful restricted entry forcesx0=0.

findings.obligation: Alias scrub precedes arena end and caller restoration
findings.evidence: Executive entry0x1dc stores scalar zeros over both halves of the16-byte sidecar;0x1e4 scalarizesx7;0x1e8..0x258 clearsx0..x29 exceptx7. The sealed outer return is then loaded at0x260; original integer callee state and FP/LR are restored at0x268..0x27c; scalarx0 comes fromx7 at0x280. Return uses RETR c16 at0x28c, or ordinary executive error return0x290. c30 is overwritten by the restored integer LR. The wrapper clears private cells/views after native return.

findings.obligation: Gateway preserves public aliases and routes terminal failure to the same scrub
findings.evidence: Linked gateway0xffff80008003e180..0xffff80008003e25c saves/restores fullc19..c22,c17,c13 plus its sealed return; calls onlycbpf_gate_impl at0xffff80008003e1bc. U64_MAX failure selects saved executive CLR, setsx7=0 and RETR enters the common executive epilogue. No supplied native target is called.

findings.obligation: Private membership and liveness precede object read
findings.evidence: Linkedcbpf_gate_impl CHKEQ c0,c2 at0xffff80008003e320 matches retained private views. Private object tag is checked at0xffff80008003e3c0..e3c4 before LDURSW x21,[c0] at0xffff80008003e3ec. Acquisition exact-bounds construction checks both roots before refcount increment. The public view has16-byte bounds andpermissions0x20001 (LOAD|GLOBAL), excluding LOAD_CAP and STORE.

findings.obligation: Stored-authority invalidation precedes every observed release effect
findings.evidence: Linkedcbpf_consume CLRTAG at0xffff80008003e7c4 and capability store ate7c8 precede both linked atomic alternatives: LDADDL ate83c and LL/SC loop ate8fc..e904. Run trace reports A-clear withrefs3 beforeA-release refs2, thenB-read42, thenB-clear beforeB-release refs1.

findings.obligation: Restricted ambient roots are installed and later restored intact
findings.evidence: Linkedcbpf_enter installs exact16-byteRCSP at0xffff80008003eefc, writes untaggedRDDC at0xffff80008003ef00, restores trustedSP atef14, fixedc17/CLR atef18/ef20, and BRR atef24. Wrapper stores savedRDDC/RCSP as capabilities at0xffff80008003ea08/ea10 before its native call atea54 (stats alternativeebbc); reloads and restores ateb64..eb70 after cleanup. These slots are outside the restricted16-byte frame.

findings.obligation: The decisive A/B observation has balanced accounting
findings.evidence: Two cells0xffff0000001cf7c0/0xffff0000001cf7d0 refer to object0xffff800080f27e08. Trace sequences1..8 show two acquisitions, Aclear/release, Bread, Bclear/release, exit. Finalvalue42, acquired2,released2,reads1,cleanup0,refs1,tagA0,tagB0,failed0. No consumed-handle or NULL branch was executed by this run.

disassembly_supplement.reason: The original symbol-filtered runtime-linked.txt omits blocks after local mapping symbols, including atomic alternatives and the middle of cbpf_test_invoke. runtime-linked-range.txt retains the full contiguous linked span.
disassembly_supplement.inspection_mode: Existing cached container; no network; read-only kernel mount and root filesystem.

limits: The kernel final-word checker regenerates its own encoder templates. Its pass is consistency evidence, not independent translation validation.

This review covers the retained native image and bounded trusted routines; it is not a proof of compiler correctness, complete kernel isolation, global capability erasure or verifier/JIT fault tolerance.

Object assignment and initial roots are constructed from executive DDC. Provider correspondence, trusted C/assembly/compiler, normal verifier checks, image integrity, inherited exception handling and synchronous non-reentrant execution remain premises.
BTF functions are fixed contract stubs; the protected gateway implements the bounded provider effects. This is not an arbitrary external kfunc wrapper.

Runtime invalid-handle, NULL/failure, terminal-cleanup and alternate-arrangement controls are outside this initial record and are documented separately as ownership boundary controls; no invalid BPF or exploit execution was performed here.
inspection_method: Internal source and native-code inspection with AI assistance. The inspection was not independent of implementation and does not constitute independent reproduction.
